summary: Roma Green Finance Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC. The agreement allows the Company to offer and sell up to $200 million of its Class A ordinary shares from time to time through the sales agent. The Company is not obligated to sell any shares; sales are made under its existing effective F-3 shelf registration. The agent receives a 3% commission. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a transformative event.
